message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A man wearing a yellow hard hat and a suit jacket over a white shirt holds a handheld gold scale by a central ring. He smiles while looking downward. The scale's crossbar is tilted significantly. Two disembodied hands extend from the left and right edges, placing stacks of green paper currency onto the scale's two circular gold pans. One stack sits in the lower-left pan, while another is being added to the higher-right pan. The man stands against a backdrop of hazy, streaked clouds. Large red block letters "TEM" are partially visible at the top. 

Text includes "TERJEPIT BESEL NIKEL" in large white letters. Smaller white text below reads: "Wakil Menteri Hukum dan HAM Eddy Hiariej ditengarai aktif meminta uang pelicin untuk memuluskan pengesahan akta perusahaan tambang nikel. Menyiapkan alibi agar lolos dari jerat hukum. H.64". Other headlines at the top include "Skandal Mahkamah Konstitusi" and "Tarik-Ulur Bursa Kripto". A barcode, QR code, and price "RP 50.000" appear at the bottom right.
